t.p: Discover luxury through the magic of an exceptional fragrance, carefully crafted from the finest and rarest oils in the world, designed to embrace your uniqueness.

In the first phase, from the very first minute, the fragrance opens with the richness of saffron blended with raspberry and thyme. From minute 16 up to 3 hours, it reveals the luxurious notes of patchouli combined with jasmine and frankincense. Finally, from 3 hours to 10 hours after application, the scent settles into warm amber, leather, and the deep essence of Indian woods.
We designed this olfactory journey especially for you—because you truly deserve it.

We narrate a story of sophistication and elegance in this fragrance, crafted from the finest and most enduring aromatic oils in the world, to create a scent experience that captivates your senses and shines through your special moments.

Finally, from 3 hours to 10 hours after application, it settles into the deep, earthy essence of vetiver combined with the sensual warmth of musk.
We designed this olfactory journey especially for you—because you truly deserve it.

div.p: This perfume is amazing! From the first spray I felt a luxurious and comforting scent with a soft oriental touch that suits every occasion. Longevity is excellent especially on skin. It changes beautifully after hours. Became one of my favorite perfumes, highly recommend!
My experience with Perfume One from Ten Boutique was special in every detail, the scent combines luxury and longevity with an elegant design and balanced projection. Truly deserves its name!
I recently bought Perfume TWO by Ten and I'm genuinely impressed. The musky and grapefruit notes blend perfectly, creating a scent that's fresh, elegant, and modern. Lasts all day beautifully.
Bought this a few days ago and from the first spray I knew it was special! Soft yet luxurious, warm and classy. Stays noticeable for hours especially on clothes.

Amazing amazing
Super strong projection and longevity
Highly recommend
This perfume has a rich, captivating blend. The oudwood gives it depth and warmth, the jasmine adds an elegant floral touch, and it has an earthy finish. Powerful and loved by everyone around me.
Tried this perfume and honestly it's luxurious! Long lasting especially on clothes. Not overpowering but definitely gets noticed. Worth every penny.
Super elegant from the first spray you feel freshness and cleanliness with light fruity notes, then it turns warm and calm. Lasts from morning till night. Worth every penny.

From the moment I lit the Wahaj candle, it drew me in. The fragrance is light and clean, yet grounded which striking a beautiful balance between fresh florals and warm, earthy depth. A gentle hint of rose adds softness, while the subtle musk brings a comforting, cozy richness to the overall experience.
It’s a beautifully layered fragrance, ideal for winding down in the evening. Fills the room in 10–15 minutes. Minimalist jar design fits any décor.

I just tried the Wooden Sage Shampoo and Body Wash from Ten Spa and wow… I’m obsessed! The scent is so refreshing and calming, it honestly feels like a spa at home. My skin feels super clean and soft, and my hair smells amazing. Totally in love with this product!
Personally I like the product, before my hair used to fall too much, currently it's not, my hair is smooth and fresh with more volume and I would really choose the protein shampoo again and again.
This candle is pure luxury! The scent is amazing and fills the entire room from the first light. Even after blowing it out, the fragrance lingers beautifully. 10/10, will buy again!
Honestly the scent is unreal and fills the whole room. Amazing quality, especially the lid — no smoke smell after extinguishing. Highly recommend, 10/10!
Tried the Sukoon candle and the scent is warm, calming, and fills the space without being overwhelming. Burns clean with no soot, packaging is luxurious. Worth every penny.
